notes.title: Dark Stress Devlog – August 2025
notes.notes: [p]First, we focused on refining the lighting and darkness in the Dark Stress dungeon.[/p][p]Areas that should have been dark appeared bright, while bright areas looked oddly dim.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637221/6730cb8d79be9d15f8b3a1701af23e2306d18b76.png"][/img][/p][p]This is a torch scene that's also featured in the current trailer.[/p][p]As you move outward from the wall, the darkness deepens, and the wall edges appear unnatural.[/p][p]When we tried simply reducing the torch's light radius to fix this, we ended up with the following result.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637221/819f638a8cb71cde3105664386312dec236518a0.png"][/img][/p][p]Although the light range was reduced, the overall scene became flat and lost its realism.[/p][p]We conducted numerous tests to solve this, and the result is shown below.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637221/54cdabd85dc13a614c52be806d4a1c1c0a563791.png"][/img][/p][p]The torchlight now spreads naturally from the center of the wall, and the brightness doesn't shift abruptly at the seams.[/p][p]In a game where players explore dark dungeons, realistic lighting is crucial for immersion.[/p][p]That's why we invested a lot of time in improving it, and we’ll continue refining it further.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Next is the current progress on combat and action development.[/p][p][/p][p]Previously, the skeleton enemy had only one attack.[/p][p]Now, it uses four different attack patterns.[/p][p]So, the player must decide when to guard, dodge, or parry based on the enemy’s behavior.[/p][p][/p][p]We still feel that it’s not dynamic enough to be called a true action game moment.[/p][p]So we plan to showcase the improved combat through a GIF or trailer next month.[/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now. We'll see you again next time. Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Dark Stress Devlog – July 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Hello. We're back to greet you after launching our Steam store page.[/p][p]Back in May, we were entirely focused on getting the store page live, so the initial version wasn’t very polished. Over the past month, we’ve concentrated on improving the playable build shown on the store page. We’ve comprehensively updated everything — trailer, screenshots, capsule images, tags, short description, and the game introduction.[/p][p]From now on, we’ll be sharing new Dark Stress content through regular development logs.
We hope these updates bring a bit of excitement while you wait for the game.[/p][p]This month in Dark Stress: [b]The Well[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637221/4426e24075e68fa9a16bfbec8f399bf41a127e6f.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Dark Stress Steam Store Page Now Open
notes.notes:
[p]The game store page is finally open.
Add our game to your wishlist to stay updated on development progress and upcoming content.[/p][p]Here are our development goals for June:
– Fix various combat bugs
– Add more realistic combat sound effects
– Design and place new traps
– Improve level layouts and components[/p][p]We’ll share our next devlog once this month’s work is complete.
Sometimes, the updates will also be reflected in the store trailer.[/p][p]Thank you for your interest and support.[/p]
